chuyentam.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders. The medallion disc is now warm soft cream-beige parchment instead of red. Her face and pose: deeply absorbed face, eyes fixed down on a book held close, a burnt-down candle and hourglass. Light posture only: both hands holding the book still; no big gesture. Both eyes looking together. Everything kept INSIDE the round medallion, the medallion drawn a bit smaller and centred so there is empty space around it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background outside the medallion, nothing else, no text.
chuyentam.B: Same young consort, same soft hand-painted storybook style, same elegant black bun with two gold hairpins, small pearl ornament and small pink flower, same jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with ivory (#F1E6D2) collar, same round gold-rimmed warm soft cream-beige parchment medallion as the reference. NEW: she is DEEPLY ABSORBED in reading and leans slightly OUT of the round medallion toward the viewer: her head and shoulders come a little forward over the gold rim, her hands overlap the gold ring; small calm gesture only, no big arms, no waving, no extra hands; both hands holding an open book propped on the gold rim close to her face, eyes fixed down on the page, lips closed, calm; a tiny hourglass beside her. Wide jade green sleeves visible. Both eyes looking together. The medallion stays round and centred, a bit smaller, with her popping slightly out of it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background, nothing else, no text.
chuyentam.out: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green the whole time. The young consort with the gold hairpins inside the round gold medallion becomes absorbed: she leans a little forward over the gold rim holding an open book close in both hands, her eyes fix down on the page, calm and focused, a tiny hourglass beside her; she comes out of the round frame only a little toward the viewer. Small calm movements only, exactly two hands, no big arms, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Smooth, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
chuyentam.loop: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green. The young consort with the gold hairpins leaning slightly out of the round gold medallion stays absorbed in a slow loop: her eyes follow the lines down the page, she turns one page slowly with her fingers, stays calm and focused; the tiny hourglass sand trickles; then she settles back to exactly the starting pose. Small calm movements only, exactly two hands, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Slow enough to read, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
